threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the SIS, integration services, and campus systems across the enterprise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Education is a frequent ransomware target; large attack surface (about 22,300 endpoints, 28 sites, 285,000 student identities); legacy imaging system (R-007); help desk MFA reset path (R-004)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-10; all High processes (P05)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 98% of endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual tier-1 DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Retire the imaging system (POAM-008); prove the SIS RTO (POAM-006); verified MFA resets (POAM-013); enterprise ransomware exercise with the disclosure committee (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Exfiltration of student records and customer information during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer information on about 2.3 million consumers; large SIS extracts in the data platform; egress monitoring tuned for known patterns
regulatory_driver: N61-R02 (16 CFR 314.4(c)(8); 314.4(j)); state breach laws; SEC Item 1.05
existing_controls: Data loss prevention on email and web; egress alerting; database activity monitoring on the SIS
treatment_plan: Bulk-export detection (POAM-015); remove ISIR-derived fields from analytics (POAM-004); dispose of over-retained records (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: Large outbound transfers investigated; records held beyond retention

threat_event: Student account takeover redirects Title IV credit balance refunds to attacker bank accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Student MFA optional; refund bank details change with email confirmation only; 212 confirmed cases in 2025-26
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 portal; SYS-01 student financials; BP-05
existing_controls: Bot detection; breached-password checks; daily bank-change reconciliation; manual review of changes over $5,000
treatment_plan: Required student MFA; step-up MFA and out-of-band confirmation for bank changes; 72-hour hold on new bank details (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Confirmed redirection cases per month; share of students enrolled in MFA

threat_event: Help desk social engineering resets MFA for a workforce or adjunct account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 24x7 help desk resets MFA after knowledge-based questions; 3,800 remote adjuncts make caller identity hard to confirm (P07 IA-5)
existing_controls: Call recording; reset alerts to the user's manager after the fact
treatment_plan: Video identity verification with manager approval before any MFA reset; reset alerts to the SOC (POAM-013)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management
key_risk_indicator: MFA resets without verification; reset-related incidents

threat_event: Former adjunct faculty or their stolen credentials keep access to the LMS and SIS grade entry after their contract ends
threat_source: Former workforce member or credential thief
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adjunct non-renewals are not recorded as terminations; 9 of 60 sampled adjunct separations disabled 8 to 43 days late; 214 inactive adjunct accounts enabled (P07)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 College tenant; SYS-01 grade entry
existing_controls: MFA on all adjunct accounts; grade change approval by registrar
treatment_plan: Record non-renewals as terminations; automated disablement when a contract ends without renewal (POAM-001)
key_risk_indicator: Adjunct accounts enabled after contract end

threat_event: Synthetic identities enroll in online programs to obtain Title IV funds ("ghost students")
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Online applications rely on document upload for identity; fraud rules sit only in the CRM; 1.8% of 2026 online applications flagged
existing_controls: CRM fraud rules; financial aid review of flagged applications; OIG referrals
treatment_plan: Identity verification for first-time online students before the first disbursement; shared fraud signals between enrollment and financial aid (POAM-023)
key_risk_indicator: Flagged applications; confirmed fraudulent enrollments; OIG referrals made

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported operating system on the legacy document imaging system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS; local accounts outside SSO; no SIEM logs; about 14 million scanned aid and tax documents
affected_asset_or_process: Legacy imaging system (colocation); SRLP verification documents
existing_controls: Segmented VLAN; EDR agent; no internet access
treatment_plan: Migrate documents to a cloud content service and retire the system (POAM-008); interim log forwarding (POAM-009)
key_risk_indicator: Days to retirement; open critical vulnerabilities on the system

threat_event: FAFSA-derived ISIR fields are used outside aid administration in the data platform, models, and marketing analytics
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly SIS extract includes ISIR-derived fields; no purpose check on the route (P07 AC-4, PT-3)
regulatory_driver: HEA section 483; N61-R02 (16 CFR 314.4(c)(2)); Title IV (34 CFR 668.16(c)(1))
existing_controls: Data use register (incomplete); role-based access in the data platform
treatment_plan: Remove the fields from the extract; purge copies; register approved uses (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: ISIR-derived fields present outside aid systems

threat_event: Enrollment advisors view academic and account records of students who are not their applicants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All 2,100 enrollment advisors hold an SIS inquiry role covering every student (P07 AC-6)
existing_controls: Annual FERPA training; access logged
treatment_plan: Narrow the role to assigned applicants and newly matriculated students for 30 days (POAM-003)

threat_event: SIS recovery exceeds the 8-hour RTO during a regional cloud outage or ransomware recovery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integration services and SAIG servers rebuilt by hand; 11.5-hour recovery in the 2026-04-25 test
existing_controls: Warm standby region; immutable backups
treatment_plan: Automate the rebuild of integration and SAIG servers; retest (POAM-006)

threat_event: LMS vendor outage longer than the BIA RTO halts online instruction for the College and all SL-2 partners
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single multi-tenant LMS; contract RTO 24 h against an 8 h BIA RTO; no observed failover test
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 (Availability); content exports
treatment_plan: Negotiate an 8-hour RTO and an observed failover test; publish read-only course packets each week (POAM-007)

threat_event: A third party holding student data suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 37 of 260 vendors with student data lack a current review; 19 legacy contracts lack Safeguards Rule and FERPA direct-control terms
existing_controls: Tiered vendor program; contract template since 2024
treatment_plan: Complete reviews and amend legacy contracts (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Vendors without current review; contracts without required terms

threat_event: A material incident is disclosed late or inaccurately, or its Title IV consequences are missed, because the materiality process fails under pressure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Playbook omits Title IV consequences; not exercised since the General Counsel and CFO changed in 2026 (P07 IR-8)
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Title IV (34 CFR 668.16(c)); N61-R02 (16 CFR 314.4(h)(4))
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter; 8-K templates
treatment_plan: Update the playbook; tabletop on 2026-11-12 (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: Days since the last disclosure committee exercise

threat_event: The admissions scoring model deprioritizes applicants through proxies for protected characteristics
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-002 enabled before committee review; fairness testing by the vendor only; no applicant notice; Colorado SB26-189 and California ADMT duties begin 2027-01-01
regulatory_driver: Title VI; Section 504; Colorado SB26-189; N61-R02 (16 CFR 314.4(c)(2))
existing_controls: Advisors can call any inquiry; scores shown as a priority hint only
treatment_plan: Local fairness test; applicant notice; human review rule; state law readiness (POAM-019; P10)
key_risk_indicator: Flag-rate ratios by group; inquiries never contacted

threat_event: The student-success risk model directs outreach unequally across student groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-003 uses LMS login frequency and ISIR-derived fields; last fairness test on 2025 data
existing_controls: Committee-reviewed model; advisors decide outreach
treatment_plan: Retrain without ISIR-derived and login-count features; retest fairness each session (P10)
key_risk_indicator: False positive rate gap by group

threat_event: AI use cases run without governance review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 16 AI use cases not yet reviewed; AI features can be switched on inside SaaS tools
existing_controls: Intake form; approved AI tools list
treatment_plan: Complete reviews; block AI features without an inventory ID (POAM-019)

threat_event: Bulk export of SIS data by an insider or a compromised account goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No detection content for bulk report exports or mass record views (P07 SI-4, AC-2(12))
existing_controls: Database activity monitoring for privileged users; DLP on email
treatment_plan: Detection content and export thresholds (POAM-015)

threat_event: Phishing of financial aid staff leads to misuse of Department system access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 640 aid staff with Department system accounts; aid-themed lures; role-based training below target
existing_controls: Monthly phishing simulations; MFA on Department systems
treatment_plan: Raise role-based training completion (POAM-018); isolate SAIG servers (POAM-016)
key_risk_indicator: Aid staff phishing click rate; training completion

threat_event: An attacker reaches the SAIG transmission servers from a compromised integration server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAIG servers share the integration subnet (P07 SC-7)
existing_controls: Host firewalls; EDR; MFA for administrators
treatment_plan: Dedicated segment (POAM-016)

threat_event: Customer information kept beyond any business need is exposed in a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSNs and aid documents of former students kept indefinitely; no disposal (P07 SI-12)
existing_controls: Encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Records schedule and first disposal run (POAM-010)

threat_event: An attacker uses default passwords on networked scanners in the financial aid processing center to read cached verification documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 31 scanners kept vendor default admin passwords; web admin pages reachable from the staff network; not in the CMDB (P07 IA-5, CM-8)
existing_controls: Staff VLAN; scanners have no internet access
treatment_plan: Change passwords (done 2026-08-13); add to the CMDB; device baseline; restrict admin pages (POAM-012)

threat_event: Stale partner faculty accounts in SL-2 tenants expose partner students' records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Partners administer their own tenant accounts with no attestation
existing_controls: Partner agreements assign account duties to partners
treatment_plan: Quarterly partner attestation and inactivity disablement in SL-2 tenants (POAM-022; P09)

threat_event: Vulnerabilities on SIS servers stay open past SLA and are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 60 sampled critical findings closed after the 15-day SLA (P07 RA-5, SI-2)
existing_controls: Weekly scans; WAF in front of web tiers
treatment_plan: Patch window changes and SLA escalation (POAM-014)

threat_event: An unauthorized or untested change to the SIS or integration corrupts grades, enrollment status, or aid
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 40 sampled emergency changes lacked retroactive approval; 3 lacked test evidence (P07 CM-3)
existing_controls: Change advisory board; daily disbursement reconciliation
treatment_plan: Emergency change rules and weekly review (POAM-014)

threat_event: Incident notices from the Title IV third-party servicer and other vendors arrive too late for FSA and FTC deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servicer contract allows 10 days; several legacy contracts have no notice term
existing_controls: Notice terms of 72 hours in the template since 2024
treatment_plan: Amend the servicer contract to 72 hours (POAM-020) and legacy contracts (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Contracts with notice longer than 72 hours

threat_event: Contact-center overflow vendor agents misuse CRM access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 300 vendor agents hold CRM accounts
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; CRM role without SIS access; monthly access review
treatment_plan: Accepted with existing controls; reviewed annually

threat_event: Online proctoring recordings are exposed by the proctoring vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Webcam recordings kept 1 year; vendor SOC 2 has 2 exceptions
existing_controls: Contract deletion terms; SOC 2 review
treatment_plan: Accepted; exceptions tracked in the vendor review

threat_event: DDoS attack against the student portal or LMS during a session start
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Session starts concentrate traffic
existing_controls: Edge WAF and DDoS service; LMS vendor DDoS service
treatment_plan: Session-start runbook with the edge provider

threat_event: A hurricane disables the Florida colocation data center and Florida campuses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Imaging system and telephony core in one Florida facility
existing_controls: Provider generators; cloud workloads in other regions
treatment_plan: Retire the imaging system (POAM-008); test telephony failover (R-031)
key_risk_indicator: Systems still hosted in the colocation facility

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted vendor update (SIS, LMS plug-in, or LTI tool)
threat_source: Nation-state or criminal supply chain actor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many LTI tools and SIS patches; limited staged rollout
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 reviews; test environment
treatment_plan: Staged rollout for tier-1 software; SBOM requests for tier-1 vendors

threat_event: Telephony core failure or an untested bank fallback stops student support, admissions calls, or refunds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Telephony core in the colocation facility; cloud failover and secondary bank refund file never tested
existing_controls: Dual carriers; overflow vendor; paper checks
treatment_plan: Test the cloud contact-center failover and the secondary bank refund file before the 2027-01 session start

threat_event: SOX IT general control failure in the student billing and revenue systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Revenue recognition depends on SIS enrollment data
existing_controls: SOX ITGC testing; no deficiencies in FY2025
treatment_plan: Accepted; covered by the SOX program

threat_event: The emergency notification service or its procedures fail during a campus emergency that coincides with an IT outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual test does not include an IT outage scenario; contact lists come from the SIS
existing_controls: Redundant carriers; campus public address systems
treatment_plan: Add an IT outage scenario to the annual test; weekly offline contact list export (POAM-024)

threat_event: Credential stuffing against student portal accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Students reuse passwords; MFA optional
existing_controls: Bot detection; breached-password checks; rate limiting
treatment_plan: Required student MFA (POAM-002)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: Grade or transcript tampering through a compromised faculty account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Faculty grade entry from any location; grade changes after posting need registrar approval
regulatory_driver: N61-R01 (34 CFR Part 99); Title IV (34 CFR 668.16(c)(1))
existing_controls: MFA; registrar approval of posted grade changes
treatment_plan: Grade change anomaly report to the registrar each week

threat_event: A lost or stolen workforce laptop exposes student data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 15,500 laptops, many used remotely
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted; encryption makes exposure unlikely

threat_event: Student records are emailed to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High volume of student communication
existing_controls: DLP warnings for SSNs; FERPA training
treatment_plan: Recipient warnings for external domains; disclosure record step in the incident process

threat_event: Partner roster feeds use shared transfer credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three SL-2 partners share one transfer account
existing_controls: TLS transfer; IP allow lists
treatment_plan: Individual transfer accounts for each partner

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes storage that holds SIS extracts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many analytics storage buckets
existing_controls: Guardrails block public storage; daily posture scans
treatment_plan: Extend guardrails to analytics sandboxes

threat_event: A privileged cloud administrator account is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small number of high-impact roles
affected_asset_or_process: Cloud provider A and B organizations
existing_controls: PAM; FIDO2 keys; just-in-time access
treatment_plan: PAM session analytics for privileged users (SI-4(20))

threat_event: Staff paste student records into unapproved generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Easy access to public AI tools
existing_controls: Approved AI tools list; training
treatment_plan: Block unapproved generative AI domains; approved enterprise assistant only

threat_event: The generative AI teaching assistant gives students wrong or harmful answers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-005 in pilot in 40 courses
existing_controls: Course-scoped content; faculty review of answers sampled
treatment_plan: Output sampling and escalation path (P10)

threat_event: An AI writing-detection score is used to accuse students of misconduct
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Detection feature available in the LMS
existing_controls: Academic integrity policy
treatment_plan: Detection scores disabled for misconduct decisions (P10)

threat_event: Student progress is shared with an employer without a valid FERPA consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consent records incomplete for 6% of sampled sponsored students
existing_controls: Consent flag in the portal
treatment_plan: Consent record cleanup and automated expiry (POAM-021)
key_risk_indicator: Sponsored students without consent on file

threat_event: The FERPA annual notice does not cover vendors and partners acting as school officials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notice predates the AI vendors and SL-2
existing_controls: Annual notice published
treatment_plan: Update the annual notice (POAM-021)

threat_event: A financial aid insider alters ISIR data or awards to create fraudulent aid
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Aid staff can edit awards
existing_controls: Separation of awarding and disbursing; audit trail; annual compliance audit
treatment_plan: Accepted with existing controls

threat_event: A ransom is paid to a sanctioned party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pressure during an outage
existing_controls: POL-03 4.7 requires CEO, General Counsel, insurer, and OFAC check
treatment_plan: Accepted with the policy control

threat_event: A zero-day in an internet-facing edge device (VPN or firewall) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy VPN concentrators at 6 campuses
existing_controls: Emergency patch process; zero-trust gateway for administrators
treatment_plan: Retire legacy VPN concentrators; emergency patch SLA 72 hours

threat_event: Campus Wi-Fi is used to reach staff systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Open student Wi-Fi at 23 campuses
existing_controls: Student and staff networks separated; NAC at 18 of 28 sites
treatment_plan: Accepted; NAC expansion in the network roadmap

threat_event: Backups are deleted or corrupted before ransomware detonates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Attackers target backups
existing_controls: Immutable backups in separate accounts; quarterly restore tests
treatment_plan: Accepted with strong existing controls

threat_event: The data platform over-retains and over-shares student data for analytics
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Data sets copied for projects without expiry
existing_controls: Data access roles
treatment_plan: Data set expiry; purpose register (POAM-004)

threat_event: LTI tools are installed in the LMS without security or privacy review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Faculty request tools during term
existing_controls: Academic technology approval list
treatment_plan: Privacy and security review step for each new LTI tool

threat_event: Clinical clearance records (immunizations, background checks) are sent to placement sites by email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,900 placement sites with different intake methods
existing_controls: Consent at placement; DLP warnings
treatment_plan: Secure portal for clearance records

threat_event: Late detection because the imaging system and SAIG software logs are not in the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local logs only (P07 AU-6)
existing_controls: EDR on both
treatment_plan: Log forwarding and use cases (POAM-009)

threat_event: A breach is not reported to FSA immediately as the SAIG Enrollment Agreement expects
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Aid staff unfamiliar with the intake form before 2026
regulatory_driver: SAIG Enrollment Agreement; Title IV (34 CFR 668.16(c))
existing_controls: P08 runbook step; Vice President, Financial Aid trained
treatment_plan: Include the FSA step in the 2026-11-12 tabletop

threat_event: The FTC 30-day notice is missed because discovery is not recognized when an employee or agent first knows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Discovery counts from the first day any employee, officer, or agent knows
existing_controls: Reporting within 1 hour (POL-03 4.2); runbook discovery log
treatment_plan: Vendor contract notice terms (POAM-005; POAM-020)

threat_event: Audit log retention is too short for an investigation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS vendors keep logs for different periods
existing_controls: SIEM keeps 1 year online and 7 years archived
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: Loss of key SOC staff reduces detection coverage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small senior SOC team
existing_controls: MSSP overflow contract
treatment_plan: Accepted; MSSP covers gaps

threat_event: Physical intrusion into a campus network room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 campuses with network rooms
existing_controls: Badge access; CCTV
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: Vendor-originated incidents are handled without notification timelines or containment confirmation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 25 sampled vendor incidents lacked those steps (P07 IR-4)
existing_controls: SOC case templates
treatment_plan: Vendor incident template and checklist (POAM-017)

threat_event: A new SL-2 partner or online program launches without security due diligence
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Partner onboarding is commercial-led
existing_controls: Contract template
treatment_plan: Security and privacy checklist in partner onboarding

threat_event: Workforce members fall for aid-themed phishing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Seasonal FAFSA and refund themes
existing_controls: Monthly simulations; reporting button
treatment_plan: Targeted training for repeat clickers; role-based completion (POAM-018)

threat_event: An insider trades on knowledge of a material incident before disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Responders learn material facts early
existing_controls: Insider trading policy; special blackout (POL-05 4.9)
treatment_plan: Accepted with the policy control

threat_event: Tracking pixels on admissions and portal pages share student data with advertising platforms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tag manager changes by marketing without privacy review
existing_controls: Consent banner on public pages
treatment_plan: Remove pixels from authenticated pages; privacy review for tag changes

threat_event: Campus safety systems (access control panels) are compromised over the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Panels on a campus VLAN
existing_controls: Separate VLAN; vendor remote access through PAM
treatment_plan: Panel credential audit at all campuses

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor bank changes requested by email
existing_controls: Call-back verification for vendor bank changes
treatment_plan: Automated vendor bank-change verification in the ERP
